patch_description:
This version uses a deterministic hybrid search designed specifically for the eleven-point Heilbronn triangle problem. It keeps the three outer vertices fixed, explores both structured boundary/interior templates and Dirichlet-distributed starts, then performs adaptive simulated-annealing mutations focused on points participating in small-area triangles.

The strongest candidates from all restarts are subsequently polished with SLSQP using the fixed orientation pattern of all triangle determinants. This converts the final local stage into a constrained maximin optimization problem. The implementation caches its final result, uses vectorized determinant evaluation, includes feasibility validation, and retains a safe valid fallback if SciPy optimization is unavailable or fails.
